scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:all && npm run copy-static
scripts.build:all: npm run build:js && npm run build:simple && npm run build:testm3 && npm run build:renew
scripts.copy-static: node -e "const config = require('./config.json'); require('fs').cpSync('dist', config.baseDir, { recursive: true }); require('fs').copyFileSync('test.html', config.baseDir + '/test.html'); require('fs').copyFileSync('index.html', config.baseDir + '/index.html'); require('fs').copyFileSync('simple.html', config.baseDir + '/simple.html'); require('fs').copyFileSync('testm3.html', config.baseDir + '/testm3.html'); require('fs').copyFileSync('renew.html', config.baseDir + '/renew.html'); require('fs').copyFileSync('vendor/forge.min.js', config.baseDir + '/forge.min.js');"
